message.content: {"base_author": ["Prioritizes avoiding the criminalization of 1.2 million Swedes over paying penalty fees for file sharing.", "Argues that laws should reflect reality rather than trying to change human behavior.", "Claims the music industry will lose its distribution control and survive only as a service bureau if it adds value.", "Asserts that enforcing copyright in the digital age requires constant monitoring of all private communications, which is unacceptable."]}
